recipes.name: Cacik
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53256. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put a sieve over a large bowl, line it with a thick sheet of non-dyed kitchen paper or a clean muslin cloth, and spoon in the yogurt. Cover with another sheet of kitchen paper and leave to strain in the fridge for a minimum of 12 hrs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the lemon juice, most of the olive oil and the dried mint to a bowl and stir well for the dried mint to soften and soak up the juices. Mix in the strained yogurt, then pour away the strained yogurt liquid and leave that bowl to one side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Halve the cucumber(s) lengthways and remove the seeds by running a teaspoon from the top to the bottom of the flesh, halve the cucumbers widthways to make them shorter and easier to handle, then coarsely grate each one into the bowl the yogurt was straining over. Using clean hands (or a clean muslin cloth), squeeze as much of the liquid out of the cucumber as possible.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: step 4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Add the strained, grated cucumber, garlic and ¾ tsp flaky salt to the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Garnish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of dried mint.

recipes.name: Corba
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52977. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Pick through your lentils for any foreign debris, rinse them 2 or 3 times, drain, and set aside.  Fair warning, this will probably turn your lentils into a solid block that you’ll have to break up later

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In a large pot over medium-high heat, sauté the olive oil and the onion with a pinch of salt for about 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook for another 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the tomato paste and stir it around for around 1 minute. Now add the cumin, paprika, mint, thyme, black pepper, and red pepper as quickly as you can and stir for 10 seconds to bloom the spices. Congratulate yourself on how amazing your house now smells.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Immediately add the lentils, water, broth, and salt. Bring the soup to a (gentle) boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: After it has come to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover the pot halfway, and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the lentils have fallen apart and the carrots are completely cooked.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: After the soup has cooked and the lentils are tender, blend the soup either in a blender or simply use a hand blender to reach the consistency you desire. Taste for seasoning and add more salt if necessary.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Serve with crushed-up crackers, torn up bread, or something else to add some extra thickness.  You could also use a traditional thickener (like cornstarch or flour), but I prefer to add crackers for some texture and saltiness.  Makes great leftovers, stays good in the fridge for about a week.

recipes.name: Griddled flatbreads
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53272. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Tip the flours into a food processor. Add the yeast, sugar and 1tsp salt, then mix well. Pour in 350ml warm water and the oil, then process to a soft dough. Mix for 1 min, then leave until doubled in size, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Pulse the dough a couple of times just to knock out the air, then tip onto a floured surface. Cut the dough in half and roll out one half to a rectangle about 20 x 40cm. Trim the edges using a large sharp knife, then cut into eight 10cm squares. Line a large tray or two baking sheets with non-stick paper and arrange the bread rectangles over the tray in one layer. Repeat with the other half of the dough. Leave in a warm place for about 30 mins until the dough is just starting to rise.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Place bread directly onto the BBQ racks and cook for a couple of mins until they puff up, then flip over and cook on the other side. Tip into a basket and serve with the dips.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Drain the chickpeas into a sieve set over a bowl or jug to catch the liquid. Tip the chickpeas, tahini, garlic and yogurt into a food processor or blender and whizz to smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Whizz in a tbsp of the chickpea liquid at a time until you have a nice consistency, then scrape into a bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Stir in a squeeze of lemon juice and season to taste.

recipes.name: Kumpir
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52978. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: If you order kumpir in Turkey, the standard filling is first, lots of butter mashed into the potato, followed by cheese. There’s then a row of other toppings that you can just point at to your heart’s content – sweetcorn, olives, salami, coleslaw, Russian salad, allsorts – and you walk away with an over-stuffed potato because you got ever-excited by the choices on offer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Grate (roughly – you can use as much as you like) 150g of cheese.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Finely chop one onion and one sweet red pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Put these ingredients into a large bowl with a good sprinkling of salt and pepper, chilli flakes (optional).

recipes.name: Smoked aubergine purée
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53259. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat grill to very hot. Slice the aubergines in half lengthways, then grill for 25 mins, turning occasionally, until soft – the skin will remain firm, but the flesh will soften. Lift the aubergines off the grill and leave until cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Using a sharp knife, score the grilled flesh and scoop out the flesh with a spoon. Tip into a bowl and mash with a fork until you get a thick pulp. Beat in the lemon juice and garlic. Add the yogurt and dill, and season. Serve while still warm.
